name: Your Lead Intake and Qualification System: Reliable, Easy to Maintain

parameters.content:
## Your Lead Intake and Qualification System: Reliable, Easy to Maintain

### How it works
- A lead fills in your website or ad form and n8n catches it in seconds.
- OpenAI scores it against your own qualification rules and says why in one sentence.
- Qualified leads go straight to the right team's inbox; every lead lands in the tracker.
- Every morning the Dashboard tab and a short email show leads by source, team and status.

### Setup
- Fill in 0 - Config: Your Settings: your rules, teams, inboxes and Sheet ID.
- Point your website or ad form at the webhook in step 1.
- Connect OpenAI, Gmail and Google Sheets once in n8n credentials.
- The morning report (steps 10, 12 and 13) and alerts (step 15) take your Sheet ID and email too.
- Set this workflow as its own Error Workflow in its settings so step 14 fires.

### What I need from you
- Your qualification rules: what makes a lead worth your team's time.
- Your teams, what each one handles, and each team's inbox.
- Which forms send you leads today, and roughly how many a day.
- Your industry and form fields: the post did not name them, so the sample lead is made up.

nodes.name: Overview

parameters.content:
## 1 - YOUR LEAD CAPTURE FLOW

Your website form, an ad lead form or anything that can send a webhook posts here. Names, emails and phones are cleaned up first, and blank submissions stop before they cost an OpenAI call.

nodes.name: Section - 1 - YOUR LEAD CAPTURE FLOW

parameters.content:
## 2 - QUALIFY EVERY LEAD WITH OPENAI

OpenAI scores each lead against the qualification rules you write in plain English in Config, and says why in one sentence. A missing budget or timeline lowers the score instead of being guessed.

nodes.name: Section - 2 - QUALIFY EVERY LEAD WITH OPENAI

parameters.content:
## 3 - ROUTE QUALIFIED LEADS TO THE RIGHT TEAM

You list your teams and their inboxes once in Config. OpenAI picks the team, this step finds its inbox, and a lead it cannot place goes to your default inbox.

nodes.name: Section - 3 - ROUTE QUALIFIED LEADS TO THE RIGHT TEAM

parameters.content:
## 4 - YOUR LEAD STATUS TRACKER

Every lead lands in one Google Sheet, qualified or not, with its score, team and reason. Your team moves the Status column on to Contacted, Booked, Won or Lost.

nodes.name: Section - 4 - YOUR LEAD STATUS TRACKER

parameters.content:
## 5 - YOUR REPORTING DASHBOARD

Every morning the Dashboard tab is rebuilt from the tracker: leads today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days and all time, by source, team and status, and who is still waiting for first contact. The same numbers arrive by email.

nodes.name: Section - 5 - YOUR REPORTING DASHBOARD

parameters.content:
## 6 - RELIABLE: IF ANYTHING BREAKS, YOU HEAR ABOUT IT

Nothing fails quietly. Any failed step emails you the step, the error and a link to the run, and the lead waits in that run for a retry.

messageValues.message: You qualify inbound leads for a business that sends each qualified lead to one of its teams. You receive one lead from the website or ad form, the business's own qualification rules, and its list of teams with what each team handles. Judge the lead only against those rules; never add criteria of your own. score is 0 to 100 for how closely the lead matches the rules. qualified is true only when the rules are met. team is one team name copied exactly from the list; if no team fits, or the lead is not qualified, return Unassigned. When a field the rules depend on is missing or vague (budget, timeline, what they need), do not guess it: lower the score, name the field in missing_info and say so in reason. Spam, sales pitches aimed at the business, job applications and test entries are not qualified, score 0, and reason says which one it is. reason is one plain sentence. summary is two sentences a team member can act on without opening the tracker. Use only facts written in the lead. Never promise the lead anything.

nodes.name: 4 - OpenAI Scores the Lead Against Your Rules
nodes.notes: Your rules live in Config in plain English: change them there and the next lead is judged by them.
